estimand.contrast: fresh noise-trained Lite recipe minus A1 PC-Wiener (A1 method LMMSE), paired within environment
estimand.test_access: fixed post-hoc comparison in a project whose formal test outcomes were historically accessed; not blind and not causal

noise_lite.required_reader: load_validated_replay; require exact manifest, CPU smoke, root approval, replay identity, complete 480-row summary and every row receipt before returning records

a1_pcw.required_reader: read_complete_marker first, then analyze_completed_run; require the exact six-cell completion ledger, all 1080 model rows and their bound environment receipts

pairing_contract.target_energy_match: math.isclose(rel_tol=1e-12, abs_tol=1e-18); noise-Lite cells must also retain the same exact target-energy value within each environment
pairing_contract.global_channel_scale: For each speed, the A1 fit channel_scale must equal the frozen noise-Lite replay snapshot global channel_scale exactly; reject any mismatch.
pairing_contract.normalizer: A1 fit normalizer SHA must equal the noise-Lite replay snapshot normalizer SHA.
pairing_contract.row_identity_failure: Any missing, duplicate, unexpected, nonfinite, nonpaired, or incomplete row fails the whole comparison; never filter bad rows or select favorable conditions.

noise_identity_audit.time_coordinates: The transform verifies the observed origin-9 through origin coordinates; the keyed helper draws the same full ten-frame board per environment/origin/user. It does not put the predictor method/source in the RNG key.
noise_identity_audit.same_observation_condition: Same raw MAT history and exact global channel_scale, seed, SNR, environment, origin, user, and ten-frame geometry imply identical noise-added history values across A1 PC-Wiener and both fresh Lite recipes. Runtime channel_scale and normalizer equality are fail-closed checks.
noise_identity_audit.audit_exposure: A prior repository-wide metadata search returned only A1 result-file paths and method_label lines; no row was opened as a result table, parsed, summarized, or used in this source preparation.

bootstrap.shared_resamples: One 10000 x 30 environment-index matrix per speed is reused for all 12 recipe/history/metric contrasts at that speed.
bootstrap.interval: Pointwise percentile 95% interval of the equal-environment paired difference; NumPy linear quantiles.
bootstrap.inference: No p-values, no additional significance family, no seed-robustness claim.
